name: tower-spec-apply
description: Main's Tower spec apply tower-spec-apply.mjs and its Jet twin TowerSpecApply.jet (#5072 c15): for each card in a spec, read the card, rewrite, replace (one criterion or every open one), remove and add criteria, change the title, body and plan, and print the changes; with --go, write the card patch, the log line and the closing evidence through the Tower writer. The fixtures hold a stand-in Tower checkout whose reader prints cards from cards/N.json (one wrapped in {card}, one bare with non-ASCII text, one for the failures) and a stand-in writer that prints its arguments and the patch. The dry spec exercises every change, the Object.entries order of rewrite keys, UTF-16 cuts through a surrogate pair, JavaScript's whitespace in the removal note and each failure the original throws, an unknown card included; the go spec writes them; a missing and a broken spec exit 1.
